name: אינטגרל לא מסוים של e^x·sin(kx) (באנגלית)
generalfeedback:
Outline: Integrate by parts twice; the original integral appears again, so solve the resulting equation for it.
Step 1 — First integration by parts
Integration by parts: \( \int u\,v'\,dx=uv-\int u'\,v\,dx \)
In order to solve this problem we will have to use the method of integration by parts as follows: Let \(u = {{CT:2}}\) and \(dv = {{CT:3}} d{{CT:1}}\). Then \(du = {{CT:4}} d{{CT:1}}\) and \(v = {{CT:5}}\). So,

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}} &= \int u dv \\ &= uv - \int v du \\ &= {{CT:2}}\cdot \left({{CT:5}}\right) - \int {{CT:5}}\cdot \left({{CT:4}}\right)d{{CT:1}} \end{aligned} \]

Step 2 — Second integration by parts
In order to solve

\[ \int {{CT:5}}\cdot \left({{CT:4}}\right)d{{CT:1}} \]

we need to apply integration by parts again defining \(u = {{CT:6}}\) and \(dv = {{CT:7}} d{{CT:1}}\). Then \(du = {{CT:8}} d{{CT:1}}\) and \(v = {{CT:9}}\). So,

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:5}}\cdot \left({{CT:4}}\right)d{{CT:1}} &= \int u dv \\ &= uv - \int v du \\ &= {{CT:6}}\cdot \left({{CT:9}}\right) - \int {{CT:9}}[{{CT:8}}d{{CT:1}}] \\ &= {{CT:6}}\cdot \left({{CT:9}}\right) - \int {{CT:10}}d{{CT:1}} \\ &= {{CT:6}}\cdot \left({{CT:9}}\right) + {{CT:11}} \end{aligned} \]

Step 3 — Solving for the integral
Hence,

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}} &= {{CT:2}}\cdot \left({{CT:5}}\right) - \left({{CT:6}}\cdot \left({{CT:9}}\right) + {{CT:11}}\right) \\ &= {{CT:12}} \end{aligned} \]

Thus,

\[ {{CT:13}} = {{CT:14}} \]

And so,

\[ {{CT:15}} = {{CT:16}} \]
